acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Ira remembers the contentious family gatherings of holidays past - and how things have changed.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Scaachi Koul is trying to learn a language native to her parents, and heads back to Calgary to ask why they never taught it to her in the first place.
acts.title: How Do I Say This?

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Singer-songwriter Loudon Wainwright III asked his ex-partner Suzzy Roche and their daughter Lucy to perform at his wedding party. The song they picked was…surprising.
acts.title: You Probably Think This Song is About You

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Reporter Kevin Sieff travels from Mexico to Chicago with a group of seniors reuiniting with their undocumented kids in the U.S., some for the first time in decades.
acts.title: Pigeons on a Plane
